versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

- Updated credential handling: now reads the API key only from an api_key file in the skill directory, and no longer supports environment variables or per-user/global config locations.
- Clarified usage: api_key file must be created, overwritten, and stored locally only after explicit user confirmation.
- Changed request parameter handling: always include sourceType=5 in API calls and detail it in request examples if the user asks.
- Added .clawhubignore to exclude runtime files like api_key from version control and publishing.
- Removed maintainer instructions and sync script reference from the documentation.

- Added requirement to include the internal routing parameter sourceType in every ComPDF API request, without exposing it to users.
- Updated workflow steps to reflect this new internal parameter handling.
- No other user-facing changes.
- Removed sample file: skill-card.md.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md from the project.
- Updated the API key help link UTM parameters for clarity and platform attribution.

- Initial release of compdf-word-to-pdf skill.
- Convert Word documents to PDF using the official ComPDF Server API.
- Preserves fonts, layout, images, and structure in output PDFs.
- Guides workflow for selecting endpoints, building accurate requests, and handling API keys.
- Supports only Word-to-PDF operations (no other Office formats).
